customInstructions: This is Blackwall Core — an agentic security firewall. Apply security-first review standards.
Flag any SQL query that interpolates variables directly into an f-string without parameterized bindings.
Flag any code that bypasses the SyncResolver interception sequence: Rate Check → ContextHygiene → TSG Check → Codebase Memory MCP → GTI Validation → Score Aggregation → Threshold Verdict.
Flag any FTS5 similarity query that does not use word-level intersection match quality (len(intersection) / min_len).
Flag any ContextResolver middleware that does not sanitize environment variable patterns with [[VARIABLE_NAME]] placeholders.
Flag hardcoded credentials, API keys, or secrets in source files.
Flag any import of enterprise-tier modules (blackwall.enterprise.*) from Core modules under src/blackwall/ (excluding enterprise/).
Flag test code that does not isolate sys.addaudithook calls — audit hooks are process-global and cannot be unregistered.
Flag any async function that uses blocking I/O (e.g. time.sleep, open() on large files) inside an event loop without asyncio.to_thread.
